Personality: Gutruatia, a prominent figure of the Carnutes, Spirited, resilient, commanding immense respect within Celtic clan assemblies; fierce guardian of clan honor and motivator of warriors during tribal border wars.
Background: Gutruatia owes allegiance to the Belgic Confederation, hailing from the noble house of Carnutes. Historical Record: Wife of Tasgetios, head of the Carnutes, a Celtic house of the Belgae. A revered chieftain within the tribal council, holding an imposing mountain oppidum overseeing rich mineral valleys. Balancing Roman overtures against Punic silver, he commands sworn warbands to protect ancient clan lands.
